current.preorder_policy:
Maison Rivault Preorder Policy

How preorders work
Preorder items are made after you order. Your order is a reservation for the first production run. Each product page shows the estimated ship date.

Payment
You’re charged in full at checkout. This secures your place in the production run.

Shipping timeline
Estimated ship dates are 2-4 weeks. These are estimates, not guarantees. If production or delivery is delayed, we’ll email you the updated date. If we can’t ship within 30 days of the original estimate, you can cancel for a full refund or keep your order and wait.

Mixed orders
If you order preorder and in-stock items together, everything ships together when the preorder is ready. To get in-stock items sooner, place separate orders.

Cancellations
You can cancel for a full refund any time before your order ships. Email info@maisonrivault.com with your order number.

Returns and exchanges
Once your preorder ships, our standard return and exchange policy applies. [Link to policy, or: Unworn items with tags can be returned within 14 days of delivery.]

Sizing and changes
Size or color changes are available until your order enters production. Email us as soon as possible.

Limited quantities
Preorder quantities are limited. If we sell out of a size, we’ll offer a refund or an alternative.

Questions
Contact us at info@maisonrivault.com
current.shipping_cost: Shipping is calculated at checkout based on your destination, order weight, and the shipping method you choose. Free standard shipping may be available on select orders, as shown at checkout.
current.return_conditions: Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in original condition with tags attached, and returned within 30 days of delivery. Discounted, leather, and personalized items are final sale. Returns must be approved in writing before you send anything back.
current.return_shipping: Customer pays return shipping. Customers should email help@maisonrivault.com for a return authorization and return address first, and shouldn’t send items back to the address on the shipping label.
